sentences.en: The driver was thrown from his seat head over heels.
sentences.zh: 司机被抛出座位，头朝下。

sentences.en: The back seat of the car will hold three passengers.
sentences.zh: 汽车后座可以容纳三名乘客。

sentences.en: There is no sense in standing when there are seats available.
sentences.zh: 有空座的时候站着是没意义的。

senses.zh: 座，座部，位子，所在地，中心
